description: This is a C++ source file containing a unit test for the WPEFramework core library. It uses Google Test framework to verify the loading and handling of shared libraries related to the core library functionality.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: A class representing a dynamically loadable library, with methods to load functions, check load status, and retrieve error messages and library names.

methods.name: simpleSet
methods.description: A Google Test unit test that verifies loading and copying behavior of the Library class, specifically checking that libraries are loaded correctly and that their state can be copied and assigned appropriately.
